title: Nutty Springy Russian Baby Squid Skewers
description: Quick-fix Russian dish featuring baby squid, air-fried to perfection with a nutty flavor, this recipe is a great option for a snack or light meal, and is jain-friendly as it does not include any animal products except seafood.

ingredients.name: baby squid
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the baby squid pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a bowl, mix together the walnut oil, chopped walnuts, lemon juice, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto the squid pieces.
Place the skewers in the air fryer and cook for 5 minutes.
Shake the skewers halfway through cooking to ensure even cooking.
Remove the skewers from the air fryer and serve hot.
Garnish with additional chopped walnuts if desired.
